notes.title: Demo patch 4 notes
notes.content:
This update is mostly geared towards making the game easier to learn, and visual and gore improvements

[b]Tutorials[/b]:
[list]
[*] Add additional text in Level 1 to make gameplay mechanics easier to understand
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]:
[list]
[*] Reduce left hand ability cost for all difficulties
[*] Demon Repellent can now cause Propulsion, but it must be aimed directly at the ground
[/list]

[b]Visuals[/b]:
[list]
[*] First person player shadows will now show legs moving
[*] Hydro Ripper will destroy small body parts instead of dismembering them (larger parts will still be dismembered)
[*] Enemies with eyes will have their eyes explode when their heads are destroyed
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]:
[list]
[*] Rapid kills now show different text for consecutive kills (ex: Double Kill, Triple Kill)
[*] Allow accessing Pause menu from the intro area in Level 1
[*] Show Shield time remaining bar underneath crosshair in HUD
[*] Replaced Stamina icon in HUD with Stamina bar
[*] Recolored Health bar to always be red
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Enemy pelvis' can now be destroyed if enough of their body is dismembered
[*] Fix candle lighting in the ritual room in Level 1
[*] Enemies will no longer scream if they are killed by a headshot
[*] Enemy spawn sound no longer cuts off if lots of enemies are spawning at the same time
[*] something about size 2 fish
[/list]

notes.title: Demo patch 3 notes
notes.content:
[b]Visuals:[/b]

notes.title: Demo patch 2 notes
notes.content:
[b]Water Shaping[/b] is now no longer available in the demo due to the difficulty curve involved with learning how to use this effectively. [b]Water Gat[/b] is now available in its place, and [b]Water Shaping[/b] will be available as an unlock later in the game. This change also introduces Calculations and Brain Power to the player one level earlier.

If you already unlocked [b]Water Shaping[/b], it is automatically replaced with [b]Water Gat[/b] on existing saves.

Full changes list:

[list]
[*]Kills now give you more [b]Brain Power[/b]
[*][b]Water Shaping[/b] replaced with [b]Water Gat[/b]
[*]Hydro Bomb ignition fire effects now stick to the burnt enemies body when they are flung back
[*]Slud's sliding animation now loops seamlessly
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1 notes
notes.content:
[b]Abilities[/b]:
[list]
[*] Demon Repellent now costs Essence to use
[*] Demon Repellent requires a cooldown after one shot, but its cooldown is shorter
[*] Demon Repellent now has homing
[*] Faster Microwave Blood Burst effect
[*] Microwaved enemies now float backwards only slightly
[*] Less screen obstruction when using Crusader Shield
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]:
[list]
[*] Improved Lightning Bolt release sound
[*] More water-y release sound for Hydro Ripper
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]:
[list]
[*] Improved idle and shoot animations
[*] Renamed difficulties
[/list]
